question: Naphthalene on complete combustion produces—
solution: The correct answer is __**CO₂ and H₂O**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • **Naphthalene** is a hydrocarbon, specifically a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH), with the molecular formula **C₁₀H₈**. • Upon complete combustion, hydrocarbons react with oxygen to produce **carbon dioxide (CO₂)** and **water (H₂O)**. This is a fundamental chemical reaction governing the combustion of organic compounds. • **Complete combustion** implies that there is sufficient oxygen to ensure that all the carbon atoms in the fuel are oxidized to **CO₂** and all hydrogen atoms are oxidized to **H₂O**. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.* • During the combustion process, **carbon monoxide (CO)** is produced only when there is incomplete combustion due to insufficient oxygen. Therefore, CO is not produced during complete combustion. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.* • Naphthalene does not contain sulfur, so its combustion cannot produce **sulfur dioxide (SO₂)**. *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.* • **Methane (CH₄)** is not a product of naphthalene combustion; it is a separate hydrocarbon. Naphthalene cannot produce methane during combustion. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.* • ***Hence, the correct answer is CO₂ and H₂O.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ __ • **Complete Combustion Reaction:** • The general chemical equation for the combustion of hydrocarbons like naphthalene is: **C₁₀H₈ + 12O₂ → 10CO₂ + 4H₂O** • This equation shows that naphthalene reacts with **oxygen (O₂)** to produce **carbon dioxide (CO₂)** and **water vapor (H₂O)**. Heat energy is also released during this exothermic reaction. • **Characteristics of Naphthalene:** • **Physical Properties:** Naphthalene is a white, crystalline substance with a distinctive smell. It is used widely in mothballs and as a precursor in the chemical industry. • **Chemical Properties:** It is a stable compound but burns readily in the presence of oxygen, releasing energy. • **Uses:** Naphthalene is used in **pesticides, dyes, and plastics**. It is also a byproduct of coal tar distillation. • **Incomplete Combustion:** • Incomplete combustion occurs when there is insufficient oxygen. This leads to the formation of **carbon monoxide (CO)**, which is toxic. • Incomplete combustion also produces soot (unburnt carbon particles), causing environmental pollution. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__ • **Environmental Impact:** • Combustion of hydrocarbons like naphthalene contributes to **carbon dioxide emissions**, which are a leading cause of global warming. • Proper combustion with sufficient oxygen minimizes **pollutants** like carbon monoxide and particulate matter. • **Applications of Naphthalene:** • Used in the manufacture of **dyes, resins, and lubricants**. • Naphthalene derivatives are used in **pharmaceuticals** and organic synthesis. 26c:T2a43,
